summary: Iteration 58 frontend flows verified end-to-end. Solution Kits (route confirmed = /dashboard/inventory/kits, NOT /dashboard/material-kits) shows all 6 filter chips with counts (filter-all / on-grid / off-grid / hybrid / solar-pump / solar-camera). Kit Categories dialog: add 'TEST58 Street Light' → row kit-cat-row-test58-street-light appears; rename via kit-cat-rename/edit-input/edit-save works; retire toggle + reactivate round-trip works; built-in rows (on-grid/off-grid/hybrid/solar-pump/solar-camera) have no toggle (locked) as required. New Solar Camera kit created: category select → kit-category-option-solar-camera hides capacity fields (kit-capacity-input/kit-cap-min/kit-cap-max all absent), description shows 'Product kit — a standalone bundle...', 2 lines saved, card renders with 'Solar Camera' badge and 'standalone bundle' text. Switching category back to On-Grid re-renders Nominal/Range Min/Range Max capacity fields (verified in first create dialog). New Project wizard (/dashboard/projects/new → advanced to 'Proposed Solution & Materials' step): kit-browser <details> lists 9 kits; TEST58 Solar Camera row shows browse-add-<id> and NO Replace button; clicking + Add succeeds → toast 'Added 2 line(s)…', 4MP camera + 8ch NVR appear in Selected Items. Then clicking + Add on On-Grid Starter · 3 kW appends 7 lines (toast 'Added 7 line(s) from On-Grid Starter · 3 kW') and camera lines remain (appended, not replaced). Brand Returns (/dashboard/returns): admin created return → delete-return-<id> opens return-delete-dialog with title 'Delete return', confirm button disabled at 0 and 2 chars, enabled at ≥3 chars, submit with reason → toast 'Return deleted (snapshot kept in audit log)' and card disappears. Staff (test58staff@sensoper.com created via POST /api/auth/register) sees button 'Request delete', dialog title 'Request deletion', submit → toast 'Deletion request sent to a manager/admin for approval', badge return-delete-pending-<id> shows 'Deletion awaiting approval', delete button removed. Admin Approvals (/dashboard/approvals) shows approvals-source-action_request chip; approval-item-action_request-<reqid> titled 'Delete brand return — TEST58 Staff delete × 2.0' with type badge 'Record action'; approve-action_request-<reqid> click → toast + return vanishes from Brand Returns. History tab shows the row with type 'Record action' and outcome Approved. Purchase Inbound (/dashboard/purchase-inbound): po-number-input placeholder 'Auto: PO-HO-0188' + helper 'Will be PO-HO-0188' correct. Blank number → auto-generated PO-HO-0188 badge, toast 'created'. Custom 'TEST58-M-001' → success, badge shows TEST58-M-001. Same supplier + 'test58-m-001' (different case) → inline po-number-error 'PO number \'test58-m-001\' already exists for TEST58 Vendor (created 2026-09-29, status pending). Use a different number.' + toast, form stays open. Changing supplier to 'TEST58 Vendor B' with same number → succeeds. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: TESTID NAMING MISMATCH: Review request specifies 'Replace' button testid = browse-replace-<id> but actual code (/app/frontend/src/pages/SiteVisitForm.js line 1264) uses data-testid={`browse-apply-${k.id}`}. Behavior is correct (Replace button rendered only when k.system_type exists) but the testid should be renamed to browse-replace-<id> to match spec/tests.

HYDRATION WARNING (non-blocking, dev-only): PurchaseInboundPage.js line 203 renders a <span> inside an <option> for the inventory select. React logs: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Remove the wrapping <span> in the option children.

MaterialKits page route is /dashboard/inventory/kits (not /dashboard/material-kits as review request stated) — spec was outdated; App.js line 136 confirms actual route. No fix needed but worth updating spec/docs.
